Animal-form ratings (Wits is always 0). In animal form, a Strength among the place's tags gives +1 die; a Weakness, +1 Difficulty (one of each at most).

d6FrameSneakForceMoveSenseStrengths (+1 die)Weaknesses (+1 Difficulty)

2Canines3334Open, CrowdHigh
3Birds2144High, OpenNarrow
4Critters4133Narrow, CrowdOpen
5Heavies2433Open, LockedNarrow, Crowd
6Reptiles3333Water, DarkCrowd

Animal perks work in animal form only. Roll a d6 within the frame: 1–2 the first, 3–4 the second, 5–6 the third. No two Bonded in a group have the same animal.

FrameAnimalPerk
Big CatsJaguarNight Rosettes: In Dark places, your Sneak rolls are at −1 Difficulty.
Snow LeopardAmbush: Your first Strike in each Clash is at −1 Difficulty.
CheetahBurst: Once per scene, Push a Move roll without spending Wild.
CaninesCoyotePack: Once per scene, Help without spending Wild.
Shepherd DogGood Dog: In Crowds, your Sneak and Sense rolls are at −1 Difficulty.
Red FoxWily: Once per scene, when your roll Fails, it becomes a Partial instead.
BirdsPeregrine FalconKeen Eyes: In Open or High places, your Sense rolls are at −1 Difficulty.
Barn OwlSilent Wings: In Dark places, +1 die on Sneak and Move rolls.
RavenClever Beak: Against Locked things you can roll Wits in animal form (rating 2) to work latches, keys and switches.
CrittersHouse MouseTiny: In Narrow places, your Sneak and Move rolls are at −1 Difficulty.
Brown RatGnaw: Against Locked things, your Force rating is 3.
Grey SquirrelLeaper: In High places, your Move rolls are at −1 Difficulty.
HeaviesBisonShaggy Coat: Once per scene, when you'd take Hurt, take 1 less.
MooseAntler Sweep: Once per scene, when your Strike against a Beater or Hound Succeeds, it's out at once.
HippopotamusCharge: Once per scene, when a Force roll Succeeds, it counts as a Critical.
ReptilesAlligatorLurker: In Water, your Sneak and Force rolls are at −1 Difficulty.
PythonCoil: When your Strike Succeeds, the next roll anyone makes against that threat this Clash is at −1 Difficulty.
Komodo DragonTaste the Air: +1 die on Sense rolls, and a Hound's Tracker doesn't affect you.

Every perk works in any form unless it says otherwise; a perk's die counts towards the Cap. Roll two d6: the first picks the list (1–3 A, 4–6 B), the second the row.

A (1–3)B (4–6)
1Football Player: +1 die on Force rolls.Team Captain: The team starts every mission with 1 Edge.
2Hide-and-Seek Champ: +1 die on Sneak rolls.Animal Whisperer: +1 die on rolls against Hounds, or to get past an obstacle they guard.
3Track Star: +1 die on Move rolls.Swim Team: +1 die on rolls in Water.
4Scout: +1 die on Sense rolls.Gymnast: +1 die on rolls in High places.
5Brainiac: +1 die on Wits rolls (human form).Night Owl: +1 die on rolls in Dark places.
6Gamer: Start every mission with 1 extra Wild.Drama Kid: +1 die on rolls in Crowds.

Threats never roll. Strike, Distract or Slip Away against their Difficulty; they are out when their harm taken equals their Toughness.

ThreatDifficultyToughnessHarmSpecial
Beater221—
Hound231Tracker: Sneak rolls at an obstacle a Hound guards are at +1 Difficulty.
Trapper221Net: When you Fail against a Trapper, you're Netted instead of Hurt.
Huntsman342Trophy: Sneak rolls at an obstacle a Huntsman guards are at +1 Difficulty.
Master of the Hunt———Arrives: Only when the Hunt is Up. Masters are never fought. While they're here, any Fail means you're Taken.
